title: Bot tasks and memory
intro: Follow task progress and manage your Bot's long-term memory.
modelSettingsHint: Just chat with your Bot—words and emoji are both welcome. Received, sent and generated files are saved in Resources.
usage: Today: {{requests}} requests · {{knownTokens}} known tokens · {{unknownReservedTokens}} unknown reserved · {{knownCost}} known cost · {{unknownCostRequests}} requests with unknown cost
memoryPolicy: When enabled, the Agent decides which stable information is worth remembering and organizes it in the background. You can review, edit, delete or restore memories; the Agent chooses the consolidation strategy and timing.
scopeHint: null inherits enabled skills; [] disables all; [IDs,…] intersects with enabled skills. MCP dependencies are never automatically granted.
memoryEditHint: Edit the content only; the Agent and server maintain its scope, type and source.
memoryCreateHint: Write what you want the Bot to remember; scope, type and source are handled automatically.
deleteHint: The same old source cannot automatically recreate this memory. You can explicitly restore a historical version.
